verdict.rationale: Grafana has documented provisioning via config files for dashboards/data sources that are version-controllable (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-11), a dedicated observability-as-code workflow supporting Terraform-like/API-based CI/CD provisioning (grafana-docs-3, grafana-docs-16), and a CLI usable in CI/CD pipelines (grafana-docs-26, grafana-probe-5) plus an OpenAPI-described API (grafana-probe-3) that enables programmatic dashboard/alert management. Missing for 10: explicit first-party Terraform provider documentation/example and independent hands-on confirmation of Terraform-based provisioning workflows.
